note: ALL death animations are PROCEDURAL, not sprite-frame sequences — no death bitmaps exist in the binary to extract. Each entry is a behavior spec for a 3D rebuild. Roll = rand(11) per corpse at processing time (rerolled while roll==8 and Suspend-Dirt flag set). Cases 0-5 (and ascension) run a 40-tick flash + rising 1000->4000 Hz tone on the tank color first. Kill award + die taunt fire at roll time; dead-tank sweep re-runs until no chain kills.

single blast, radius word [0x1242] (small), tank color
expanding ball FX, rand(6)+5 steps, blue-white DAC swatch
